# Keep DOM attributes, slots and CSS properties in distinct documentation fields

SearchBar documents label/disabled/maxlength as attributes, placeholder/search-button as slots and --search-bar-* names as CSS properties. Its implementation forwards label to the input aria-label, reads maxlength during connection and dispatches autocomplete with the current value. UnifiedToolbarButton separately exposes a JavaScript badge accessor that updates an attribute. Recommend preserving these contract categories rather than treating every public name as a writable JavaScript field. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/base/content.
